codex.reaction_formula: Reaction power = base × wave level + Attack × scale, boosted by Elemental Mastery and reaction bonuses. Reactions ignore Defense but not resistance. Each pair has a short per-target cooldown and chains stop after 2 generations.
codex.title: Codex
enemy.ash_imp.desc: Ignaroth's spawn. Bursts into flame when it dies, scorching heroes beside it.
enemy.ash_imp.name: Ash Imp
enemy.banner.desc: Nearby enemies gain +25% speed and +15 Defense. Kill it first.
enemy.banner.name: Banner Imp
enemy.crystal_parasite.desc: Darts past heroes and latches onto the Crystal. Latched parasites take 60% less damage unless a hero guards the core; Light or any cleanse rips them off.
enemy.crystal_parasite.name: Crystal Parasite
enemy.flame_devourer.desc: Shrugs off Fire, and every Fire hit stokes its speed. Weak to Water: swap damage sources or Vaporize it.
enemy.flame_devourer.name: Flame Devourer
enemy.frost_wraith.desc: Phases through attacks (35% less damage) unless Illuminated, glides over ground fields and shrugs off slows.
enemy.frost_wraith.name: Frost Wraith
enemy.goblin_sprinter.desc: Fragile runner that bursts into a sprint every few seconds. Slows, roots and wide coverage on its lane stop it.
enemy.goblin_sprinter.name: Goblin Sprinter
enemy.gravemaw.desc: Very slow and heavily armoured. Shells the Crystal area, then vents its armour—strike while it is Exposed. At half HP it breaches forward along its lane.
enemy.gravemaw.name: Gravemaw, the Siege Titan
enemy.grunt.desc: Basic melee attacker. Fights heroes in its way.
enemy.grunt.name: Rift Grunt
enemy.hex_binder.desc: Ranged caster that periodically Silences the nearest hero, blocking skills. Steadfast heroes and cleanses counter it.
enemy.hex_binder.name: Hex Binder
enemy.hexcaster.desc: Ranged. Targets heroes from 3.6 m, then the Crystal.
enemy.hexcaster.name: Hexcaster
enemy.ice_statue.desc: Seraphyne's guardian. While any statue stands she takes 45% less damage. Statues are immobile and melt fast to Fire.
enemy.ice_statue.name: Ice Statue
enemy.ignaroth.desc: Erupts lava under heroes (watch the telegraphs) and summons Ash Imps. At half HP it Overheats: resists Fire, is weak to Water and Ice, scorches nearby heroes, and periodically vents—strike while it is Exposed.
enemy.ignaroth.name: Ignaroth, the Ember Tyrant
enemy.ironback_golem.desc: Heavy plates halve basic-attack damage until its armour is cracked or Corroded. Use skills, reactions, Earth or Poison.
enemy.ironback_golem.name: Ironback Golem
enemy.juggernaut.desc: Huge and crowd-control resistant (65% shorter stuns, slows and pushes).
enemy.juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
enemy.mana_leech.desc: Drains magic: heroes within 2.6 m recover skill cooldowns 35% slower. Kill it first, or bring Steadfast heroes and cleanses.
enemy.mana_leech.name: Mana Leech
enemy.mimic.desc: Adapts: every 3s it hardens against the element that hurt it most (partial resistance).
enemy.mimic.name: Prism Mimic
enemy.ravager.desc: Elite. Telegraphs a charging slam at the most threatening hero.
enemy.ravager.name: Ravager
enemy.rift_warden.desc: Final boss. Phase 1 summons; phase 2 marks a lane and assaults down it; phase 3 casts three slams then is Exposed (+50% damage taken).
enemy.rift_warden.name: The Rift Warden
enemy.riftling.name: Riftling
enemy.runner.desc: Very fast. Ignores heroes unless body-blocked.
enemy.runner.name: Rift Hound
enemy.sapper.desc: Ignores heroes and taunts; detonates on the Crystal for heavy damage.
enemy.sapper.name: Bomb Sapper
enemy.seraphyne.desc: Marks the ground with frost that freezes heroes standing in it (watch the telegraphs). Raises Ice Statues that shield her, then unleashes a blizzard that slows nearby heroes' attacks. Weak to Fire.
enemy.seraphyne.name: Seraphyne, Queen of Winter
enemy.shieldbearer.desc: Armored; its tower shield blocks 60% of frontal hits. Strike from the side or crack its armor.
enemy.shieldbearer.name: Shieldbearer
enemy.siege_colossus.desc: Stops far from the core and shells the Crystal with telegraphed artillery. Flankers and long range reach it.
enemy.siege_colossus.name: Siege Colossus
enemy.siegebreaker_golem.desc: Mini-boss. Telegraphed charge slams; at 50% HP gains heavy armor for 7s. Armor Crack and Superconduct cut through it.
enemy.siegebreaker_golem.name: Siegebreaker Golem
enemy.soul_binder.desc: Links up to 3 nearby allies: they take 40% less damage and the binder absorbs that share. Kill the binder to break the links.
enemy.soul_binder.name: Soul Binder
enemy.spirit_splitter.desc: Splits into two Spirit Wisps when it dies. Area damage cleans up both halves.
enemy.spirit_splitter.name: Spirit Splitter
enemy.spirit_wisp.desc: A quick fragment of a Spirit Splitter. Wisps never split again.
enemy.spirit_wisp.name: Spirit Wisp
enemy.spore_carrier.desc: Releases a spore cloud on death that regenerates enemies inside. Kill it away from the pack; weak to Fire.
enemy.spore_carrier.name: Spore Carrier
enemy.stone_burrower.desc: Tunnels underground where it cannot be hit, then surfaces near the core after a short rumble. Keep defenders on the inner ring.
enemy.stone_burrower.name: Stone Burrower
enemy.storm_harpy.desc: Flies straight at the Crystal over walls and ground fields. Melee heroes hit it for half; ranged heroes are the answer.
enemy.storm_harpy.name: Storm Harpy
enemy.summoner.desc: Opens portals that release Swarmlings every 6s.
enemy.summoner.name: Rift Summoner
enemy.swarmling.desc: Tiny and fragile, comes in crowds. AoE shines.
enemy.swarmling.name: Swarmling
enemy.void_priest.desc: Channels a heal on nearby enemies. Any stun interrupts the channel; focus it down first.
enemy.void_priest.name: Void Priest
enemy.warded.desc: Resists all elements a little and one element heavily (shown by its ward).
enemy.warded.name: Warded Golem
event.challenge_altar.desc: Runes promise rewards for a harder next wave.
event.challenge_altar.name: Challenge Altar
event.challenge_altar.opt0: Accept the Swarm trial: +15 Gold, +1 Essence now.
event.challenge_altar.opt1: Accept the Haste trial: +8 Gold now.
event.rift_merchant.desc: A hooded trader steps out of a small rift.
event.rift_merchant.name: Rift Merchant
event.rift_merchant.opt1.drawback: Costs 10% of the Crystal's max HP.
event.wandering_healer.desc: A healer offers help in exchange for little.
event.wandering_healer.name: Wandering Healer
event.wandering_healer.opt2: Ask for armor training (card: Reinforced Plate).
evo.ashara_rebirth_ward.desc: A phoenix guardian: taunts, and her bursts and rebirth shield the team.
evo.ashara_rebirth_ward.name: Rebirth Ward

evo.ashara_rebirth_ward.skill.name: Warding Slash

evo.ashara_vengeance_flames.name: Vengeance Flames
evo.ashara_vengeance_flames.skill.desc: Sweeps enemies within {radius} m for {mult%} Attack as Fire and gains {heat} Heat. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.ashara_vengeance_flames.skill.name: Vengeful Slash
evo.borun_fortifier.desc: Long bastions that grind attackers and protect nearby heroes.
evo.borun_fortifier.name: Fortifier
evo.borun_fortifier.skill.desc: Raises a {duration}s bastion (up to 3) that slows, cracks armour, grinds enemies and gives heroes beside it 15% damage reduction. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.borun_fortifier.skill.name: Bastion
evo.borun_spike_mason.desc: Short-lived walls that erupt into stunning spikes.
evo.borun_spike_mason.name: Spike Mason
evo.borun_spike_mason.skill.desc: Raises a {duration}s wall; when it crumbles it erupts, damaging and stunning enemies nearby for 0.6s. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.borun_spike_mason.skill.name: Spike Wall
evo.cinder_ash_guardian.desc: Becomes a tank: wide taunting sweeps, burning ground and self-shields.
evo.cinder_ash_guardian.name: Ash Guardian
evo.cinder_ash_guardian.skill.desc: A {arc}° sweep for {mult%} Attack that taunts within {tauntRadius} m for {taunt}s, leaves burning ground for {groundDuration}s and grants a {shieldPct%} max-HP shield. Cooldown {cooldown}s.

evo.cinder_inferno_duelist.name: Inferno Duelist

evo.cinder_inferno_duelist.skill.name: Duel Flurry
evo.eirwen_ice_bulwark.desc: Thicker shields, a Crystal ward, and stunning bursts.
evo.eirwen_ice_bulwark.name: Ice Bulwark
evo.eirwen_ice_bulwark.skill.desc: Shields herself ({shieldPct%}), an ally ({allyShieldPct%}) and the Crystal ({crystalShield%}); broken shields explode and stun for {burstStun}s. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.eirwen_ice_bulwark.skill.name: Bulwark Aegis
evo.eirwen_shatter_counter.desc: Offensive paladin: explosions freeze and shatter, every third blow slams.
evo.eirwen_shatter_counter.name: Shatter Counter
evo.eirwen_shatter_counter.skill.desc: Shields herself and an ally; broken shields explode for {burstMult%} Attack (+{frozenBonus%} vs Frozen) with heavy Ice gauge. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.eirwen_shatter_counter.skill.name: Shatter Aegis
evo.freya_blizzard_witch.desc: Every nova leaves a blizzard that keeps chilling and damaging.
evo.freya_blizzard_witch.name: Blizzard Witch
evo.freya_blizzard_witch.skill.desc: {mult%} Attack as Ice damage in {radius} m, slows {slow%} for {slowDuration}s and leaves a blizzard for {zoneDuration}s. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.freya_blizzard_witch.skill.name: Whiteout
evo.freya_crystalbinder.desc: Becomes a support: novas shield the Crystal and expose Frozen enemies.
evo.freya_crystalbinder.name: Crystalbinder
evo.freya_crystalbinder.skill.desc: {mult%} Attack as Ice damage in {radius} m, slows {slow%}; shields the Crystal for {crystalShield%} max HP and Frozen enemies take +{frozenBonus%} damage. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.freya_crystalbinder.skill.name: Binding Frost
evo.glacius_permafrost_sentinel.desc: Shares its ice shield with nearby allies.
evo.glacius_permafrost_sentinel.name: Permafrost Sentinel
evo.glacius_permafrost_sentinel.skill.de: Shield worth {shieldPct%} max HP, taunt within {tauntRadius} m for {taunt}s, attackers take {retaliate%} Attack; allies within {allyRadius} m gain {allyShieldPct%} max-HP shields. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.glacius_shatter_knight.desc: Turns into a bruiser: shields explode when broken and Frozen foes take double damage.
evo.glacius_shatter_knight.name: Shatter Knight
evo.glacius_shatter_knight.skill.desc: Shield worth {shieldPct%} max HP and a {tauntRadius} m taunt; when it breaks it shatters for {shatterBurst%} Attack as Ice damage in 2 m. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.glacius_shatter_knight.skill.name: Shatter Guard
evo.ignis_ember_weaver.desc: Trades direct damage for Burn spreading and stronger reactions downstream.
evo.ignis_ember_weaver.name: Ember Weaver

evo.ignis_ember_weaver.skill.name: Ember Web
evo.ignis_meteor_archmage.desc: Trades cast frequency for huge telegraphed meteors that stun crowds.
evo.ignis_meteor_archmage.name: Meteor Archmage
evo.ignis_meteor_archmage.skill.desc: Calls a meteor that lands after {delay}s: {mult%} Attack as Fire damage in {radius} m and stuns {stun}s. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.ignis_meteor_archmage.skill.name: Meteor
evo.kael_precision_assassin.desc: Single-target finisher for elites and bosses.
evo.kael_precision_assassin.name: Precision Assassin
evo.kael_precision_assassin.skill.desc: Dashes to the strongest enemy and strikes for {mult%} Attack (+{executeBonus%} below {executeBelow%} HP). Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.kael_precision_assassin.skill.name: Cutting Gale

evo.kael_storm_shepherd.name: Storm Shepherd

evo.magnus_quake_champion.name: Quake Champion
evo.magnus_quake_champion.skill.desc: Slams for {mult%} Attack in {radius} m, stunning {stun}s and cracking armor; an aftershock 1s later deals {aftershock%} of the slam. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.magnus_quake_champion.skill.name: Quake Slam
evo.magnus_shardbreaker.desc: Single-target armour breaker for elites and bosses.
evo.magnus_shardbreaker.name: Shardbreaker
evo.magnus_shardbreaker.skill.desc: A crushing blow for {mult%} Attack that stacks Armor Crack up to {crackMax} times ({crackDuration}s). Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.magnus_shardbreaker.skill.name: Shard Breaker
evo.marina_tide_saint.desc: Pure sustain: larger, stronger rain that can revive a fallen ally once per wave.
evo.marina_tide_saint.name: Tide Saint
evo.marina_tide_saint.skill.desc: Rain ({radius} m, {duration}s) heals allies for {heal%} of Attack every 0.5s and soaks enemies. Once per wave it revives a downed ally at {reviveHp%} HP. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.marina_tide_saint.skill.name: Sacred Rain
evo.marina_torrent_caller.desc: Turns healing into offense: a damaging torrent that keeps enemies Wet.
evo.marina_torrent_caller.name: Torrent Caller
evo.marina_torrent_caller.skill.desc: A torrent ({radius} m, {duration}s) hits enemies for {mult%} Attack as Water damage every 0.5s and still heals allies for {heal%} of Attack. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.marina_torrent_caller.skill.name: Torrent
evo.nerissa_catalyst_conductor.desc: A reaction engine: soaked enemies take far more reaction damage.
evo.nerissa_catalyst_conductor.name: Catalyst Conductor
evo.nerissa_catalyst_conductor.skill.des: Soaks enemies within {radius} m Wet; they take +{reactionVuln%} reaction damage for {vulnDuration}s. Heals the most hurt ally {healPct%}. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.nerissa_pure_healer.desc: A dedicated healer: bigger heals, faster reaction tides.
evo.nerissa_pure_healer.name: Pure Healer
evo.nerissa_pure_healer.skill.desc: Heals the {healTargets} most hurt allies for {healPct%} max HP and soaks enemies within {radius} m Wet. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.nerissa_pure_healer.skill.name: Healing Tide
evo.nyxara_covenant.desc: A boss and elite hunter: one heavy oath, brittle armour, scaling damage.
evo.nyxara_covenant.name: Covenant of Ruin
evo.nyxara_covenant.skill.desc: Binds one elite or boss (else any enemy) with {doomStacks} Doom, makes it Brittle (+{amount%} damage taken for {duration}s) and hits for {mult%} Attack. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.nyxara_covenant.skill.name: Covenant
evo.nyxara_final_verdict.desc: Spreads Doom: each execution dooms its neighbours.
evo.nyxara_final_verdict.name: Final Verdict
evo.nyxara_final_verdict.skill.desc: Binds up to {marks} enemies with {doomStacks} Doom each ({mult%} Attack). Enemies she executes pass {verdictSpread} Doom to 2 enemies nearby. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.nyxara_final_verdict.skill.name: Verdict
evo.raiden_static_executioner.desc: Hunts weakened foes and executes them; bosses take bonus damage instead.
evo.raiden_static_executioner.name: Static Executioner
evo.raiden_static_executioner.skill.desc: Dashes to the most wounded enemy for {mult%} Attack. Non-boss enemies below {executeThreshold%} HP are executed; bosses take +{bossBonus%} damage instead. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.raiden_static_executioner.skill.name: Execution
evo.raiden_stormblade.desc: Every dash leaves an electrified trail that keeps striking.
evo.raiden_stormblade.name: Stormblade
evo.raiden_stormblade.skill.desc: Dashes to the most dangerous enemy for {mult%} Attack as Lightning damage and leaves a storm trail for {trailDuration}s. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.raiden_stormblade.skill.name: Storm Dash
evo.seren_aegis_of_dawn.desc: Becomes a team shield caster that also protects the Crystal.
evo.seren_aegis_of_dawn.name: Aegis of Dawn
evo.seren_aegis_of_dawn.skill.desc: Shields the most hurt ally ({shieldPct%}), every other ally within {allRadius} m ({allShieldPct%}) and the Crystal ({crystalShield%}); cleanses and sears as before. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.seren_aegis_of_dawn.skill.name: Dawnwall
evo.seren_purifier.desc: Turns her light offensive: strips every shield and buff around her.
evo.seren_purifier.name: Purifier
evo.seren_purifier.skill.desc: Sears enemies within {radius} m for {mult%} Attack (+{illuminatedBonus%} vs Illuminated), strips all shields and buffs within {purgeRadius} m, and shields the most hurt ally ({shieldPct%}). Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.seren_purifier.skill.name: Purging Dawn
evo.sylph_tempest_archer.desc: Fires a fan of three piercing arrows.
evo.sylph_tempest_archer.name: Tempest Archer
evo.sylph_tempest_archer.skill.desc: Looses {arrows} piercing arrows in a {spread}° fan, each dealing {mult%} Attack as Wind damage. Cooldown {cooldown}s.
evo.sylph_tempest_archer.skill.name: Arrow Fan
evo.sylph_wind_dancer.desc: Attacks much faster and every third basic attack pierces.
evo.sylph_wind_dancer.name: Wind Dancer

evo.terra_living_fortress.skill.name: Fortress Stance
evo.tidal_floodbreaker.desc: A bigger, harder-hitting wave that punishes Wet enemies.
evo.tidal_floodbreaker.name: Floodbreaker

evo.tidal_healing_spring.name: Healing Spring

evo.tidal_healing_spring.skill.name: Spring Wave

settings.title: Settings
status.charged.desc: Carries Lightning; the next different element reacts.
status.chill.desc: Moves 15% slower; Fire melts it for big damage.
status.doom.desc: Stacks up to 5. Non-bosses at or below 4% HP per stack are executed (half on elites); bosses take +3% damage per stack.
status.illuminated.desc: Purified: loses 50% shield and support buffs when lit, deals 15% less damage for 4s.
status.poisoned.desc: Stacking damage over time (max 10). At 5+ stacks: Corroded (-30% Defense). On death half the stacks jump to a neighbour (max 2 hops).
status.resonant.desc: The next reaction on this enemy deals +30% damage, then the mark fades.
status.rooted.desc: Held in place for 0.8s but can still attack; 1.5s immunity afterwards. Bosses are slowed instead.
status.unstable.desc: At 3 stacks the enemy collapses: a short pull and Void damage around it (2s cooldown, bosses are not pulled).
status.wet.desc: Primed for Water reactions (Vaporize, Electrocharge, Freeze...).
status.windmark.desc: Takes +10% Wind damage; Wind spreads it.
team.ascension_desc.3: + Crystal starts with 15% less max HP; one defense node is blocked each wave (shown in preparation).
team.ascension_desc.4: + Enemies deal 10% more damage; elites carry an affix.
team.ascension_desc.5: + Bosses enrage below 25% HP (+25% damage). Enemy HP scales 8% per level.
team.subtitle: You can recruit up to 6 heroes during the run.
team.title: Choose two starting heroes

trait.guardians_soul.name: Guardian's Soul
trait.label: Trait
trait.last_stand.name: Last Stand

trait.pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac

trait.quick_channel.name: Quick Channel

tutorial.1: Your heroes defend the Crystal automatically. Watch them fight!
tutorial.2: Between waves, drag heroes to nodes near the red lane arrows.
tutorial.3: Different elements combine into reactions. Mix your team!
tutorial.4: Use 2× speed when the wave is under control.
wave.1.hint: A small pack from the east. Your heroes fight on their own.
wave.1.name: First Contact
wave.10.hint: Mini-boss! Armor Crack and Superconduct break its armored phase.
wave.10.name: Siegebreaker
wave.11.hint: Massive swarm with a hasted Ravager from the north.
wave.11.name: Swarm and Fang
wave.12.hint: Ranged casters target your heroes from 3.6 m.
wave.12.name: Hexfire Line
wave.13.hint: Sappers ignore heroes and explode on the Crystal. Kill them on the way.
wave.13.name: Siege Sappers
wave.14.hint: Everything at once, with banners buffing allies.
wave.14.name: Mixed Assault
wave.15.hint: Two hardened elites. A pact will be offered after this wave.
wave.15.name: Twin Ravagers
wave.16.hint: New diagonal lanes open; enemies are hasted this wave.
wave.16.name: Diagonal Breach
wave.17.hint: Mimics adapt to your strongest element. Diverse damage wins.
wave.17.name: Prism Hunt
wave.18.hint: Sappers, juggernauts and summoners on six lanes.
wave.18.name: Siege Escalation
wave.19.hint: The final shop follows. Prepare for the Warden.
wave.19.name: Last Stand
wave.2.hint: Enemies from east and west; hounds rush the east late.
wave.2.name: Two Fronts
wave.20.hint: Three phases: summons, a marked lane assault, then a slam sequence followed by an Exposed window.
wave.20.name: The Rift Warden
wave.3.name: The Swarm
wave.4.hint: Fast runners from west and south. Block their paths.
wave.4.name: Hound Rush
wave.5.hint: An elite with telegraphed charges. Spread out of the red circles.
wave.5.name: Ravager
wave.6.name: Four Winds
wave.7.hint: Shieldbearers block frontal hits: flank them or crack their armor.
wave.7.name: Iron Wall
wave.8.hint: Summoners and casters join from the northeast.
wave.8.name: Crossroads
wave.9.hint: Warded golems resist Fire, Ice or Lightning (see their ward). Mix your elements.
wave.9.name: Warded Vanguard
